verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order by putting a tiny 'See the Flavours' button above the headline. Its one-line headline also runs almost edge to edge with hardly any side margin, so the CTA ends up buried and the hierarchy is wrong. B keeps the original order and centred alignment but is basically a shrunk copy: big empty side areas, the 'Now in four flavours' line is nearly illegibly small, and the CTA is small. It still reads correctly and stays on brand.
